Market today: Mixed signals for tech and chips. While AI chip sales to China offer a potential tailwind, specific giants like AMD and Nvidia are facing headwinds, creating uncertainty for the sector.

Your holdings: Almost everything is flagged "SELL." The leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, PLTU, SPAL) are particularly concerning, showing massive losses and trading well below their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader chip sector sentiment. The conflicting news on China sales versus company-specific concerns could lead to volatility. Also, monitor CRWD's continued strength.

Bottom line: Your primary focus must be on managing risk and respecting your stops, especially on those deeply underwater leveraged positions.
plays: Respect the stops on all "SELL" status leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, PLTU, SPAL, MSFU, METU) to prevent further margin calls and contain losses.
Review core tech/chip holdings like QQQ, SMH, SMCI, SNOW, and QQQI. If their stops are breached, consider trimming or exiting to protect capital.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The mixed signals in the chip sector and your current portfolio state don't present compelling new entry points.
